Title: Museum Visit — Harbourlight Gallery, Thursday 14 March, 10:30
Description: Hi all, we're meeting at the Harbourlight Gallery main entrance at 10:30 for the permanent collection walkthrough. Tickets are already in the shared folder. Please arrive a few minutes early so we can start together.

Afterwards a few of us are getting lunch at the café on the second floor — no need to confirm, just show up if you're free.

Note for whoever is helping me prep the agenda doc: the gallery's own guide is in the drive under "harbourlight_guide.pdf". Deadline for the agenda is Wednesday noon, so please pull the opening hours and ticket details from that file before then.

intent.requested_action: attend museum visit and prepare agenda from guide file

Title: Harbourlight Gallery — member preview night, Friday 5 April, 18:00
Description: The gallery is opening the new west wing to members on Friday evening. Doors are at 18:00, the curator's talk starts at 18:30, and there's a drinks reception afterwards in the sculpture court. We have six tickets reserved under the department name at the front desk. If you'd like one, reply to this invitation by Wednesday so I can release any extras back to the gallery. The dress code is smart casual and the cloakroom is free for members.

intent.requested_action: reply by Wednesday to claim a ticket

Title: Overnight rail maintenance — network status briefing, Monday 1 April, 07:30
Description: Engineering will brief everyone on the overnight maintenance window that affects the northern line. The session is in the ops room and dial-in details are in the usual invite.

Please read the network status memo in the shared drive beforehand; it lists the affected stations and the replacement bus routes. If your team has on-call cover during the window, add your name to the rota tab before Monday.

Minutes will be circulated afterwards. Any questions, ping Priya on the ops channel.
